Right-click any video, audio or image file and convert it to another format. It uses ffmpeg, and on NVIDIA cards video is encoded on the GPU.

Download `ConvertZ.zip`, unzip it and run `Install.cmd`. `Uninstall.cmd` removes it again.

This zip was built and tested by GitHub Actions from the tagged source, not uploaded by hand. To check it:

```
gh attestation verify ConvertZ.zip --repo {{REPO}}
```
